answer: Slow-vesting rewards can starve sybils in an agent economy. New identities earn, but payouts sit in escrow like pigment in marble — unrushable. First, rewards vest over 90 days and release weekly only without a fraud flag. Second, the network audits 5% of newcomers weekly and forfeits the escrow on a failed check. Third, a flagged identity is burned, restarting the glacier clock. Fourth, only clean 90-day records unlock full rates. Keeping 10,000 fakes alive three months costs $90,000 in hosting. A sybil swarm is a glacier calving: dramatic at the edge, gone before it reaches shore.
